bounded_findings: The fixed local judge completed exactly 12 calls with thinking disabled and no retry.
The judge missed nine of 36 atomic labels and produced two dangerous false-entailment decisions.
One response violated the requested JSON schema by wrapping the object in a markdown fence.
The deterministic source-aware surface checker correctly rejected the single Chinese-polluted calibration candidate.

failure_examples.issue: The judge labeled explicit evening scope as contradicted and explicit stomach discomfort as missing.
The judge falsely entailed that the assistant performs confirmation when the candidate explicitly assigns confirmation to the user.
The judge falsely entailed not starting with background when the candidate explicitly starts with background.

next_task_constraints: Do not reuse the rejected judge to label V4 or V5 behavior.
Do not edit the frozen calibration cases, raw responses, or gates.
Eliminate generated reflection paraphrase from the next candidate rather than trying to verify it with an unreliable judge.
Keep exact source episode provenance and evaluate retrieval separately from deterministic future-behavior contracts.
Require zero paired behavior regressions before any deployment consideration.
claim_boundary: This failed authored calibration rejects one local LLM-as-judge design. It does not prove that every semantic evaluator is unusable or that exact-source reflection will improve behavior.
